integrity: A complete mathematical derivation and reproducible standard-library exact checker accompany the finding; numerical tests are explicitly subordinate to the general proof.
scientific_limitations: Only coordinate-permutation S4 twists of the given Cayley cubic with characteristic greater than three. The finite group is presented by an exact integral matrix cokernel, without a symbolic invariant-factor classification. Historical priority requires external review.
title: Integral Picard tori and zeta functions of Cayley’s nine-line divisor
